R03.title: 7.2.4.1. Confidence intervals
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
R03.date: Undated live handbook section; reviewed 17 October 2026
R03.location: Wilson interval formula and exact binomial intervals. Tutorial intervals are calculated from R02 counts, not reported by the grid paper.

R04.title: EXACT BINOMIAL
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
R04.location: One-sided and two-sided exact binomial confidence limits. The tutorial derives the zero-failure bound from the binomial probability, with independent fixed-setting trials as an explicit assumption.
